vocabulary.meaning_en: to put something into a space or container until it is full

vocabulary.example: Fill up the gas tank before a long trip.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to eat or get as much of something as possible
vocabulary.example: Don't fill up on bread before the main course.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to complete all the information on a form
to grow bigger or stronger (body, muscles)
vocabulary.example: After three months at the gym, his arms filled out.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to write information in the empty spaces
vocabulary.example: Fill in the blanks with the correct word.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give someone information they missed
vocabulary.example: I missed the meeting. Can you fill me in?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do someone's job for a short time as a substitute
vocabulary.example: Can you fill in for John? He's sick today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to complete something by filling a hole or gap
vocabulary.example: I need to fill in the hole in the wall.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or thing that replaces another
vocabulary.example: We need a substitute teacher tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have had enough of something; you want no more
vocabulary.example: I've had my fill of bad news today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: material a dentist puts into a hole in a tooth
vocabulary.example: I had two fillings at the dentist.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (informal) to eat a lot of food quickly
vocabulary.example: He filled his face with chocolate bars.

vocabulary.meaning_en: damage to a tooth that makes a hole
vocabulary.example: Too much sugar causes tooth decay.

fine_lines.title: fill out vs fill in (forms)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما بمعنى إكمال المعلومات. fill out يُقال عن الاستمارة كاملة، وfill in يُقال غالبًا عن الفراغات (the blanks).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean complete information. Fill out is for the whole form; fill in is usually for the blanks.

examples.sentence: Fill in your name and address here.

fine_lines.title: fill someone in vs fill in for someone
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fill me in = أخبرني بما فاتني. fill in for me = خذ مكاني في العمل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Fill me in = tell me what I missed. Fill in for me = do my job while I'm away.

examples.sentence: Can you fill me in on the meeting?
Can you fill in for me tomorrow?

expressions.meaning_en: Make it full (e.g. at a gas station).
expressions.example: Fill it up, please. I'm driving far.

expressions.meaning_en: Can you tell me what happened?
expressions.example: I was late. Can you fill me in?
Welcome to the clinic. Please fill out this form.
I've had my fill of this conversation.

questions.question: "Mr. E asked James to ___ for him at work because he was sick."
questions.explanation_en: Fill in for = be a substitute.

questions.question: "James likes to ___ with chocolate bars." (eat a lot at once)
questions.explanation_ar: fill your face = يحشو فمه بالطعام.
questions.explanation_en: Fill your face = eat a lot.

questions.explanation_en: A filling repairs a hole in a tooth.
